lines.speaker: Linh (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: Good afternoon. I'll present the numbers for the July reporting period.

lines.speaker: Tuan (Finance Director)
lines.text: Please start with the top-line revenue and keep it simple.

lines.speaker: Linh (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: Revenue reached twelve billion dong, which is in line with expectations.

lines.speaker: Tuan (Finance Director)
lines.text: And how does that compare with June? Was it a flat month?

lines.speaker: Linh (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: It grew four percent. The summary table on slide two shows the details.

lines.speaker: Tuan (Finance Director)
lines.text: Good. What about the breakdown by department? Marketing worries me.

lines.speaker: Linh (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: Marketing spent more because of a one-off item, an event in Da Nang.

lines.speaker: Tuan (Finance Director)
lines.text: So that cost will not repeat next month, correct?

lines.speaker: Linh (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: Correct. I added a short commentary under each chart to explain it.

lines.speaker: Tuan (Finance Director)
lines.text: Excellent. Please send the deck to the board before Friday afternoon.

shadowing: Revenue for this reporting period is in line with expectations, around twelve billion.
The summary table on slide two shows the breakdown by department clearly.
Top-line revenue grew slightly, but costs stayed flat compared with last month.
This higher cost is a one-off item and will not repeat next quarter.
I added a short commentary under each chart so managers understand the numbers.
